sections.title: Text Generation Models
sections.desc: Qwen's core text models; the whole family supports hybrid thinking mode (the enable_thinking switch) and 1M context; vision input is covered in the "Vision Understanding" section
rows: Latest flagship, hybrid thinking on by default, ¥12/¥36
Previous-gen flagship, 50% off for a limited time
Flagship balanced choice, ¥2/¥8 (20% off, limited time), built-in tools + web
Latest lightweight, hybrid thinking on by default, ¥0.8/¥2.7
Ultra-long text (tens of millions of chars), ¥0.5/¥2

sections.title: QwQ Deep Thinking Models
sections.desc: Thinking-only mode (always reasons before answering; cannot be disabled); for a controllable switch, use the hybrid thinking mode of text generation models

sections.title: Omni-Modal Models (Omni)
sections.desc: Understands text, audio, images and video at once; outputs text and speech; for realtime voice chat see the "Realtime voice chat" row
rows: Supports thinking mode; single input limited to 150s
S2S voice chat flagship; meaningless backchannels won't interrupt

sections.title: Realtime Speech Translation (Livetranslate)
sections.desc: ~3s-latency simultaneous interpretation, works out of the box; file mode translates audio/video files
rows: Top choice for realtime interpreting; 29 speech + 31 text outputs

sections.title: Vision Understanding Models (VL / OCR)
sections.desc: Image analysis, video understanding, OCR document extraction. Note: all qwen3.8/3.7/3.6/3.5 models in the Text Generation section also support vision input (1M context, up to 2h video); the VL series adds vision-specialized enhancements
rows: Legacy visual reasoning; capability merged into Qwen3-VL

sections.title: Image Generation Models
sections.desc: Text-to-image and image editing; the qwen-image-3.0 family supports agent prompt rewriting and Chinese text rendering
rows: Image 3.0 flagship, agent prompt rewriting, small-text/multilingual rendering
Brand color palette, multi-image reference (9 images), character consistency
10x faster, ~1/5 the price, photorealistic portraits/product shots

sections.title: Video Generation Models (Wanxiang / HappyHorse)
sections.desc: Billed by output video seconds (input free); some models tiered by resolution
rows: 60% off for a limited time, latest third-party video generation
20% off for a limited time; input + output both billed
Generated by interpolating first + last frames
Transfers video motion to an image character

sections.title: Speech Recognition Models (ASR)
sections.desc: Two paths: realtime (WebSocket streaming) and non-realtime (HTTP file transcription); the Qwen-Audio-3.0 family supports hotwords and Prompt context injection
rows: Realtime recognition flagship, multilingual incl. dialects

sections.title: Speech Synthesis Models (TTS)
sections.desc: Standard synthesis / voice cloning (audio sample cloning) / voice design (created from text description); instruct mode tunes tone, emotion and speaking rate in natural language
rows: Supports SSML and LaTeX formula reading
Legacy token-billed version; migrate to Qwen3-TTS
Voice registration and management (prerequisite for voice cloning)
Creates new voices from text descriptions, billed per voice

sections.title: Embedding & Rerank Models
sections.desc: Semantic search, RAG retrieval and accuracy; rerank is recommended after Embedding retrieval to re-rank Top-N results
rows: Latest text embedding, v3-compatible dimensions, MTEB leader

sections.title: Specialized Models
sections.desc: Vertical-use models for translation, document parsing, deep research and text analysis
rows: Web search + multi-step reasoning + long reports, ¥54/¥163
Translates text in images into multiple languages, ¥0.004/image
Generates music from lyrics/prompts, billed per second

sections.title: Open-Source Models (Self-Deployable)
sections.desc: Open weights, self-deployable, no API call limits, only hardware costs; Bailian also offers hosted calling of the open-source versions
rows: Latest open-source flagship, hybrid thinking on by default

sections.title: Legacy & Retiring Models
